title: The room view
description: What rewake's shell reads of the room each second, from one hidden `rewake room --json` call (docs/shell.md#the-prefix-and-the-room): the open spaces, the sessions with their verdicts, and, when asked, the briefs. The shell's types and the command's are generated from this file by go run ./tools/protogen, so the two cannot drift.

RoomView.description: is the room as the shell draws it.

asMain.description: says the caller proved to be the shell of the room's main: only then does the view carry the sessions' telemetry and the briefs.

spaces.description: are the spaces not over, in the order they opened.

briefs.description: are the room's briefs, open ones and closed, newest first as brief list gives them; absent when none, when --briefs was not asked, and unless asMain.

briefsProblem.description: is why the briefs could not be read at all, when --briefs was asked and the list failed as brief list fails: the shell shows it as the list's line, never as no briefs; briefs is absent then.

unreadableBriefs.description: are the entries of the briefs directory that do not read as a brief: shown, never taken for absent; absent as briefs is.

brief.description: is the brief --brief named, with its text and comments; absent unless it was asked, asMain and it reads.

id.description: names the space in its record and in the pane's source.

name.description: is what main and the person call the space.

worker.description: is the worker's session name, its --name and its harness.

mainRun.description: says whether the main that opened the space still runs: the first sign of main's end the room gives, while its hosts end the workers.

socket.description: is where the space's host serves the worker's screen; the shell builds no path itself.

checkout.description: is the worker's own worktree; absent while it works where main does.

SpaceState.description: is a space that is not over: opening, open, or closing.

RunState.description: is whether a run lives: running, ended, or unknown when that cannot be told.

branch.description: is the branch checked out there.

SessionRow.description: is a running session as main sees it, for the strip under its pane.

own.description: marks the shell's own main, the run the caller proved to be.

type.description: is the type of a worker opened with one.

cwd.description: is the directory the session started in.

branch.description: is the branch the session works on: its space's own checkout, else what is checked out where it started, a detached head as its short commit; absent outside a repository.

verdict.description: is what rewake judged the session does; absent while the room view carries no telemetry.

model.description: is the harness's display name of the model, else the template's label, else the id.

thinking.description: is whether the model thinks, where the harness tells it.

used.description: is the tokens the context holds.

window.description: is the limit the conversation is kept to, in tokens.

percent.description: is how full the context is, in percent of the window.

cache.description: is the prompt cache, where the harness says; absent when unknown.

mirror.description: is where the session's wrapper serves its conversation to rewake's own face (docs/face.md), while it does; absent otherwise and unless asMain. The shell builds no path itself.

Mark.description: is the edge of a session's button in the shell.

Verdict.description: is rewake's verdict on a session's activity (docs/session-state.md#activity): the shell shows it and derives nothing.

activity.description: is the word for what the session does: idle, working, compacting, waiting for a permission, waiting for an answer, waiting at a dialog or unknown.

label.description: is the activity as a person reads it, with (stale) once it is not current.

blocked.description: is what the session waits on: permission, question or dialog; empty when on nothing.

stale.description: says an observed activity is not current.

mark.description: is the edge of the session's button.

CacheRow.description: is a prompt cache as the strip shows it.

hit.description: is the hit percent of the last request.

expiresAt.description: is when the cache expires, in epoch milliseconds, where the harness says.

BriefView.description: is a brief; in the list without text and comments, which only the opened brief carries.

edition.description: counts main's edits; a tick names it.

done.description: counts the current edition's items ticked.

bound.description: are the runs the brief was sent to.

text.description: is the current text with the ticks applied; only on the opened brief.

comments.description: are the comments in order; only on the opened brief.

skills.description: are the names of the skills the brief gives, from its text's Skills line.

BriefBound.description: is a run a brief was sent to.

run.description: says whether that run lives; its right ends with it.

kind.description: is the run's right to the brief.

BriefComment.description: is a comment on a brief.

from.description: is the session that wrote it.

at.description: is when, as an RFC 3339 time.

capacity.description: is the kind of the writer's binding when it wrote; absent on a comment written before kinds, which shows the name alone.

BindingKind.description: is a run's right to a brief: work reads, ticks and comments; review reads and comments, never ticks.

Problem.description: is a file that does not read.

why.description: is why it does not read.
